evidence_summary: Producer identified silo space as a constraint during transition and possible minor batching-computer upgrades at some locations.

source_title: Reducing Alabama’s Concrete Carbon Footprint

source_title: ACI-ASCC Survey on Portland-Limestone Cement Concrete
evidence_summary: Voluntary survey of 173 concrete-industry respondents; authors caution against population-level inference.
interpretation_limit: Mixed roles; not 173 RMX producers and not a representative sample.

source_title: ACI-ASCC Survey on Portland-Limestone Cement Concrete
evidence_summary: Among responding ready-mixed concrete producers, 60% reported problems at the same frequency with Type IL as with Type I cement.
interpretation_limit: Survey respondent subset, not a population estimate; comparison concerns concrete floors and slabs.

source_title: ACI-ASCC Survey on Portland-Limestone Cement Concrete
evidence_summary: Authors stated that inconsistent percentage and dollar responses prevented calculation of a meaningful PLC versus OPC cost difference.
interpretation_limit: Do not treat this as evidence of price premium or savings.

source_title: ACI-ASCC Survey on Portland-Limestone Cement Concrete
evidence_summary: Survey comments and responses identified water demand, set times, crusting, finishing, and bleeding among frequently discussed Type IL changes.
interpretation_limit: Multiple actor roles; reports of changes do not establish failure or adoption causality.

source_title: Field Trials of Concrete Produced with Portland Limestone Cement
evidence_summary: Eight PLC concrete mixtures and a portland-cement control were tested; authors reported performance influenced by SCM level but not PLC versus PC in the studied mixtures.
interpretation_limit: Experimental performance evidence, not direct evidence of RMX commercial adoption.

source_title: Where Has Our Cement Gone? Transition to Type IL Portland Limestone Cement for Gross Reservoir RCC
evidence_summary: Local cement suppliers switched to Type IL and suspended OPC, requiring additional roller-compacted-concrete mixture trials. Reported 22 OPC trial mixtures and 53 Type IL trials.
interpretation_limit: Project-level evidence, not a named RMX plant decision.

source_title: Call For Interior Non-Air Entrained Concrete Floor Slab Mix Designs
evidence_summary: Industry groups requested successful Type I/II and Type IL floor-slab mixture designs to develop guidance intended to shorten the learning curve for Type IL mixtures.
interpretation_limit: Evidence of an organized learning initiative, not a measured adoption effect.

source_title: TCC Materials: Cement change at TCC plants
evidence_summary: TCC announced a transition from ASTM C150 portland cement to ASTM C595 Type IL because cement manufacturers were replacing OPC and OPC would no longer be available in its markets.
interpretation_limit: Applies to TCC products/plants, not necessarily ready-mix facilities; do not match to RMX inventory.

source_title: TCC Materials: Cement change at TCC plants
evidence_summary: TCC reported extensive qualification testing in its St. Paul laboratory and comparable or better product performance.

source_title: TCC Materials: Cement change at TCC plants
evidence_summary: TCC indicated that its PLC cement sources were DOT-approved in its markets and offered help with commercial-job specification approvals.
interpretation_limit: States of TCC offices do not establish states of particular PLC transitions.

source_title: ACI-ASCC Survey on Portland-Limestone Cement Concrete (including NRMCA 2023 survey)

source_title: ACI-ASCC Survey on Portland-Limestone Cement Concrete (including NRMCA 2023 survey)

source_title: ACI-ASCC Survey on Portland-Limestone Cement Concrete (including NRMCA 2023 survey)

source_title: ACI-ASCC Survey on Portland-Limestone Cement Concrete (including NRMCA 2023 survey)
evidence_summary: Most surveyed producers observed increased water demand; 60% reported increases between 1 and 2 gallons per cubic yard.
interpretation_limit: Survey sample and mixture-specific response; not a universal PLC effect.

source_title: ACI-ASCC Survey on Portland-Limestone Cement Concrete (including NRMCA 2023 survey)
evidence_summary: Forty percent of surveyed producers reported increased water-reducer dosage; most reported increased air-entraining admixture dosage.

interpretation_limit: No direct adoption timing or facility identity available.

source_title: Type IL Cement and Tilt-Up
